title: MediTrust — UI/UX Design for a Multivendor Medical Equipment Marketplace Website
intro: MediTrust International is a Bangladesh-based multivendor marketplace that connects medical equipment suppliers with hospitals, clinics, and healthcare institutes.

coverImage.alt: MediTrust medical equipment marketplace homepage displayed on a laptop

blocks.text: MediTrust International is a Bangladesh-based multivendor marketplace that connects medical equipment suppliers with hospitals, clinics, and healthcare institutes.

We designed and developed the complete website, covering the product marketplace, vendor stores, registration flows, and a medical directory, so buyers and suppliers can find and connect with each other in one trusted place.
The final website focuses on easy equipment discovery, clear supplier credibility, and a simple path from browsing to inquiry.
Sourcing medical equipment in Bangladesh often depends on personal contacts, scattered listings, and slow back-and-forth communication.

items.text: Buyers had no single place to compare equipment from different suppliers
Finding the right product among many equipment types was time-consuming
Product details like brand origin, warranty, and availability were hard to verify
Suppliers lacked a professional online presence to reach healthcare institutes
Useful resources such as ambulance services, blood banks, and supplier lists were spread across different sources

blocks.text: Designing a medical marketplace meant balancing a large technical catalogue with the trust and clarity that healthcare buyers expect.

items.text: Organizing a wide range of equipment, from lab devices to hospital furniture, into simple navigation
Presenting products where pricing is often “on request” without making the experience feel incomplete
Showing key trust signals like brand, origin, warranty, and stock status clearly on every product
Supporting multiple vendors with their own stores in a consistent design system
Serving two audiences, suppliers and healthcare institutes, with clear registration and contact flows

imageAfter.alt: MediTrust product detail page beside its searchable medical equipment listings

blocks.text: To solve these problems, we designed and built a clean, trust-focused marketplace around how medical buyers actually search and decide.

items.text: Category-first navigation with 10 clear equipment categories, so buyers reach the right product group in one click
Structured product cards showing brand, origin, warranty, availability, and price or “price on request” at a glance
Vendor stores that give each supplier a dedicated storefront inside the marketplace
Wishlist and inquiry-friendly flow that suits high-value, quotation-based purchases
Separate registration paths for suppliers and healthcare institutes, supporting a verified network
Medical directory with ambulance services, blood banks, hospital links, and supplier lists, adding everyday value beyond the store
Responsive, performance-friendly WordPress build with an easy-to-manage admin experience

blocks.text: Through research-led design and careful development, MediTrust International now has a complete, trust-focused marketplace for the healthcare supply chain.

items.text: Buyers can browse equipment by category and compare brand, origin, and warranty quickly
Suppliers get their own storefronts and a direct channel to healthcare institutes
The directory section adds useful local resources and strengthens the platform’s credibility
The site is easy for the team to manage and ready to scale as more suppliers and products join

blocks.text: Overall, this project shows how thoughtful UI/UX design combined with solid development can turn a fragmented sourcing process into a clear, trusted online marketplace for medical equipment.
